companyEnvironments.captureInProgress.en: Capture is in progress. If this state remains after a refresh or interrupted request, cancel it to return to the active template controls.
companyEnvironments.captureInProgress.zh-CN: 正在捕获。如果刷新或请求中断后仍保持此状态，请取消以返回当前模板控件。

companyEnvironments.connectTailscaleSuff.en: to choose machines from your tailnet.
companyEnvironments.connectTailscaleSuff.zh-CN: 以从你的 tailnet 中选择主机。

companyEnvironments.imageStale.en: Not in use — the environment configuration changed since this image was captured. Runs fall back to the base configuration until you capture a new image.
companyEnvironments.imageStale.zh-CN: 未使用 - 捕获此镜像后环境配置已更改。在捕获新镜像前，运行会回退到基础配置。

companyEnvironments.networkHint.en: Choose how Paperclip reaches this SSH server.
companyEnvironments.networkHint.zh-CN: 选择 Paperclip 连接此 SSH 服务器的方式。

companyEnvironments.sshUseHostAuth.en: Use authentication configured on the remote machine
companyEnvironments.sshUseHostAuth.zh-CN: 使用远程主机上已配置的身份验证

companyEnvironments.sshUseHostAuthHint.en: Use the remote user's provider login instead of the agent's Paperclip AI account.
companyEnvironments.sshUseHostAuthHint.zh-CN: 使用远程用户的提供商登录凭据，而非智能体的 Paperclip AI 账号。

companyEnvironments.tailscaleHostHint.en: Tailscale IP address or MagicDNS name of your machine.
companyEnvironments.tailscaleHostHint.zh-CN: 主机的 Tailscale IP 地址或 MagicDNS 名称。

companyEnvironments.tailscaleTestHint.en: Save this environment, then test its connection from the list.
companyEnvironments.tailscaleTestHint.zh-CN: 请先保存此环境，再从列表中测试连接。
